weapon.basketball.desc: Throws a ball at {who} within {range} m: it bounces to {hops} more {hops?enemy:enemies} within {reach} m, then flies back to his hand{way}.
weapon.big_mouth.desc: Pours a {range} m beam through the crowd for {seconds} s.
weapon.boomstick.desc: Fires {amount} {amount?pellet:pellets} in a {cone}° cone where you face.
weapon.branding_iron.desc: {amount} {amount?blade:blades} circle you at {radius} m, hitting anything they touch.
weapon.dragons_breath.desc: Breathes a {deg}° cone of fire {range} m long where you face, {seconds} s every {cooldown} s: whatever stands in it takes {damage} damage every {every} and catches fire.
weapon.flare_gun.desc: Fires {amount} {amount?flare:flares} at the nearest enemy within {range} m that is not burning yet.
weapon.frisbee.desc: {amount?Throws a frisbee:Throws {amount} frisbees, fanned out,} at the nearest enemy within {range} m, curving left or right: {amount?it cuts:they cut} through everything in a {range} m flight, each enemy after the first taking {less}% less (never under {floor}%).
weapon.gravity_gun.desc: Picks up {amount} {amount?enemy:enemies} within {range} m and throws {amount?it:them} into the thickest crowd: a {blast} m blast. What it throws takes a hit when it lands.
weapon.guitarra.desc: Strums a {deg}° cone of melody {range} m at the nearest enemy: whatever stands in it is lifted {lift} m and dropped where it stood.
weapon.hammer.desc: Brings {amount} {amount?hammer:hammers} down on the thickest crowd within {range} m: a {blast} m blast that throws them outwards.
weapon.land_mine.desc: Drops {amount?a mine:{amount} mines} at your feet every {cooldown} s: a creature that steps on it sets it off, a {area} m blast.
weapon.lob_grenade.desc: Lobs {amount} {thing} at the densest crowd. Explodes in a {area} m radius.
weapon.molotov.desc: Lobs {amount} {thing} of fire at the thickest crowd that is not burning yet. Leaves a {area} m pool of flames.
weapon.orbit_saws.desc: {amount} {amount?blade:blades} circle you at {radius} m, hitting anything they touch.
weapon.peashooter.desc: Fires {amount} {amount?shot:shots} within {range} m and aims at {who}.
weapon.poison_dart.desc: Fires {amount} {amount?dart:darts} at the nearest enemy within {range} m that is not poisoned yet.
weapon.rattlesnake.desc: {amount} {amount?blade:blades} circle you at {radius} m, hitting anything they touch.
weapon.revolver.desc: Fires {amount} {amount?shot:shots} within {range} m and aims at {who}.
weapon.rocket_pod.desc: Launches {amount} homing {amount?rocket:rockets} at {prey} within {range} m: a {blast} m blast each.
weapon.sabre.desc: Slices a {deg}° arc across {who} within {range} m{amount?:, {amount} swings a stroke}, throwing what it cuts out and aside.
weapon.salt.desc: {amount?Pours a {radius} m patch of salt in your wake every {cooldown} s. It lasts {lasts} s; enemies in it:Pours {amount} patches of salt ({radius} m) in your wake every {cooldown} s. They last {lasts} s; enemies in them} take {damage} damage every {tick} s.
weapon.skull_rain.desc: Lobs {amount} poison {thing} at the thickest crowd of healthy enemies. Leaves a {area} m cloud of green smoke.
weapon.spear.desc: Throws {amount?a spear:{amount} spears} at {who}: through everything in the way, out to {range} m, where {amount?it sticks:they stick} in the sand.
weapon.sun_scepter.desc: Calls a pillar of sunlight down on a random enemy you can see every {cooldown} s (the closer, the likelier): {damage} damage in {radius} m.
weapon.tommy_gun.desc: Fires {amount} {amount?shot:shots} within {range} m and aims at {who}.
weapon.tumbleweed.desc: Fires {amount} {amount?shot:shots} within {range} m and aims at {who}.
weapon.turret_buddy.desc: {amount?Drops a turret every {cooldown} s. It {stays}.:Drops {amount} turrets every {cooldown} s, up to {cap} standing. Each {stays}.}
weapon.zap_beam.desc: Zaps a random enemy within {range} m and chains to {chains} more.
